build_mllm_dataloader: build a multimodal dataloader for calibration using a template, model, tokenizer, and dataset name
create_llava_dataset: create an LlavaDataset instance with a template, model, tokenizer, and dataset path for supervised fine-tuning
register_custom_dataset: register a custom dataset class to the MLLM_DATASET registry using the register_dataset decorator
convert_conversations: convert LlavaDataset conversations by remapping roles and replacing tokens using covert_conversations method
clear_dataset_cache: clear the runtime cache of an LlavaDataset instance using the clear_runtime_cache method
